name: AutoWebBench
description: AutoWebBench is a bilingual benchmark for evaluating real-world web navigation tasks. It supports comprehensive evaluation of web navigation agents, addressing challenges such as HTML complexity, versatile webpage actions, and open-domain task difficulty.
reputation: A newer web-navigation benchmark that is gaining attention for bilingual, real-world task evaluation but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes HTML simplification and hybrid human-AI data collection; benchmark is bilingual and real-world focused.
